Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules linked to document CHEMBL1133512. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Filter docs by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133512'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
